items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Bill Beason was the drummer that was supposed to play when Cliff was directing the band.

ctx.x: Bill Beason was the drummer that was supposed to play when Cliff was directing the band. Bill Beason was (appointed) to Jo Jones place. And Cliff tells me, he says, man, he says, I give the down beat and Beason's beat does not fit Jo Jones.
So the next show, they just told Beason that Jo said he'd play the rest of the shows.
